payload.text: **A PLACEHOLDER SWAP CHANGES WIDTHS AND BREAKS WHAT WAS ALIGNED AROUND IT** (2026-09-16, 0425). A MODULES.md row padded to the table width while it held `ISSUE_MERGE` came out 7 characters short once `0425` went in, and the pre-commit markdown gate refused the landing mid-chain. Fill issue numbers BEFORE padding or rendering anything aligned, or run `prettier --check` on every touched markdown file in the re-prove after the fill, not only on the first build.
